system.description: A Focus for a mystic whose bond with nature grants healing, protection, and command over the wild.

abilities.name: Healing Fruit
abilities.description: Infuse a fruit or seed so that a creature can recover 1d6 from a Pool of its choice or recover a minor wound.

abilities.name: Seeds of Fury
abilities.description: Launch burning seeds at a target within long range; a successful attack deals 3 damage and sets the target alight.

abilities.name: Wild Affinity
abilities.description: A sane wild animal in its natural environment will not attack you unless provoked or controlled.

abilities.name: Communication
abilities.description: Convey a basic concept to a creature that cannot speak or understand speech, and receive a very basic answer.

abilities.name: Wilderness Experience
abilities.description: Find food and potable water in the wilderness, resist poison and natural disease, and ignore natural terrain penalties.

abilities.name: Nature's Grip
abilities.description: Use an Intellect attack to hold a foe in nearby natural foliage or clear entangling plants from an immediate area.

abilities.name: Nature's Voice
abilities.description: Calm a nonhuman beast within long range that can see you.

abilities.name: Moon Shape
abilities.description: Become a primal beast under moonlight, gaining Might and Speed until a one-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Wilderness Encouragement
abilities.description: Help an ally in short range immediately recover or remove a moderate wound while in the wilderness or discussing it.

abilities.name: Insect Eruption
abilities.description: Summon a supernatural insect swarm that hinders foes and can attack or perform suitable tasks.

abilities.name: Call the Storm
abilities.description: Create storm clouds over a very long area and call lightning down on foes.

abilities.name: Earthshake
abilities.description: Trigger a violent earth movement in a short area within very long range, damaging terrain and creatures.
